record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: Let S_N be the partial sum operator on Dirichlet series given by S_N(sum_{n=1}^∞ a_n n^{-s})=sum_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s}. Determine the precise asymptotic growth, as N tends to infinity, of the operator norm of S_N on H^1; more generally, determine it for H^p when p ≤ 1 and for p = infinity.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.5. Determine the precise asymptotic growth of the norm of the partial sum operator SN : P∞ n=1 ann−s 7→ PN n=1 ann−s when N → ∞ for p = 1 (or more generally, for p ≤ 1 or p = ∞).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a formal Dirichlet series f(s)=∑_{n=1}^∞ a_n n^{-s} and an integer N≥1, define the partial sum operator S_N by
   S_N f(s) = ∑_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s}.
For 0<p≤∞, let H^p denote the Hardy space of Dirichlet series, defined as follows. Identify each multiplicative character on the positive integers with a point of the infinite-dimensional polytorus T^∞, and for a Dirichlet polynomial P(s)=∑_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s} let
   ‖P‖_{H^p} = ( ∫_{T^∞} |∑_{n=1}^N a_n χ(n)|^p dχ )^{1/p},        0<p<∞,
   ‖P‖_{H^∞} = sup_{Re s>0} |P(s)|,
where dχ is the normalized Haar measure on T^∞ and χ(n) is the completely multiplicative extension determined by χ(p_k)=z_k for the k-th prime p_k. The space H^p is the completion of the space of Dirichlet polynomials under this norm. Each S_N extends to a bounded operator on H^p (for the appropriate ranges) and one writes ‖S_N‖_{H^p→H^p} for its operator norm.

It is a classical theorem of Helson that for 1<p<∞ the operator norm ‖S_N‖_{H^p→H^p} is bounded uniformly in N. Determine the precise asymptotic behavior, as N→∞, of ‖S_N‖_{H^p→H^p} in the remaining cases:
   (a) p=1;
   (b) 0<p<1;
   (c) p=∞.
artifact.status_search_result: Bondarenko, Brevig, Saksman and Seip (Trans. AMS, 2019, "Linear space properties of H^p spaces of Dirichlet series") obtained general upper and lower estimates for the norm of the partial sum operator S_N on H^p for 0<p≤1, supplementing Helson's classical bound for 1<p<∞. However, these estimates do not match, so the precise asymptotic growth of ‖S_N‖ on H^1, H^p (p<1), and H^∞ does not appear to be fully determined; the problem is regarded as still open in its sharp form.

status_evidence.title: Linear space properties of H^p spaces of Dirichlet series (Trans. AMS)
status_evidence.snippet: General estimates for the norm of the partial sum operator on H^p spaces of Dirichlet series with 0<p≤1, supplementing a classical result of Helson for 1<p<∞.
status_evidence.claim: Partial bounds (not sharp asymptotics) are known for p≤1; Helson's result gives uniform boundedness for 1<p<∞.

status_evidence.title: Old and Recent Results in the Analytic Theory of Dirichlet Series: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing partial sum operator norms on H^p spaces of Dirichlet series and remaining open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The precise asymptotic growth at the endpoints p=1, p<1, p=∞ remains an open problem in surveys post-2019.
